Who We Are

Decades on the ground. Now built for the digital age.

Built for Industry. Trusted for Every Project. A G Electric & Automation has grown from a local electrical counter into a trusted electrical and automation distribution partner for industries, contractors, builders, and project businesses. With strong stock, trusted manufacturer relationships, and technical expertise, we make industrial electrical procurement faster, easier, and more reliable.

We supply and distribute switchgear & protection products, energy and power monitors, electrical equipment, cables & wires, automation solutions, panel solutions, modular switches and sockets, lights, fans, and other allied electrical products. from leading manufacturers. From plant floors to project sites, we deliver the right products, dependable supply, and technical support to keep industries powered and projects moving.

The Story Behind AG Electric

Founded on trust. Built through relationships.

Mr. Ram Kumar

Founder, AG Electric & Automation

Mr. Ram Kumar brings a strong foundation in the electrical field and a deep, hands-on understanding of electrical product ranges. With a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, his approach combines technical knowledge with practical experience in selecting dependable electrical solutions for customers, projects and businesses.

Electrical Engineering Wide Electrical Product Expertise Industry Partnerships

Over the years, his experience across a wide range of electrical products and close association with industry partners has helped shape AG Electric & Automation into a business focused on product knowledge, reliable sourcing and long-term customer relationships.
